import sys, math, numpy as np

from rcb_client import Robot
from PIL import Image
r=Robot()
Q=np.array([0.,1.,0.,0.],np.float32)
def path(points, spacing=.009):
    # points list xyz; sample each straight segment by its max dimension
    out=[]
    for a,b in zip(points,points[1:]):
        a=np.array(a,float); b=np.array(b,float)
        n=max(1,int(np.ceil(np.linalg.norm(b-a)/spacing)))
        out += [a+(b-a)*i/n for i in range(1,n+1)]
    return np.array([np.r_[p,Q] for p in out],np.float32)
def go(points,note):
    arr=path(points)
    res=r.submit('ee_pose',arr,dt=.05,video='both',video_fps=5,cameras=('canvas_cam','practice_cam','side_cam','scene_cam'),note=note)
    print(note,'rows',len(arr),'plan',res.meta.get('plan'),'clipped',res.meta.get('clipped'),'steps',res.meta.get('control_steps_chunk'), 'timeleft',res.meta.get('time_left_s'))
    res.save('/app/output/cal_'+note.replace(' ','_'))
    return res
